subject: Data custody & evidence roadmap for SOC 2 / SIG gates
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearcoat.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ClearCoat Security <security@clearcoat.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: ClearCoat MAP: evidence owners + custody path questions

Rafael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are working the internal MAP and want to lock the security/compliance lane so procurement can proceed. Two quick clarifying asks before we finalize the acceptance criteria:

1) Evidence custody: for SOC 2 bridge items (logging, change control, incident records), can you confirm whether Redwood will host the evidence artifacts on our behalf (redwood-managed storage) or provide a downloadable evidence bundle for ClearCoat to ingest into our audit repository? We need the custody model spelled out for our auditors.

2) SIG/CAIQ deliverables: a) will you provide a completed CAIQ matrix with referenced attachments, or a response + pointer to docs? b) what is the expected ETA for a first-pass XLSX we can review?

3) DPA redlines: our legal team will want to see data retention windows reflected in the DPA. We attached a short template of what our auditors expect — is Redwood able to accept the retention carveouts in section 5?

Goal: have acceptance gate items recorded in the MAP by Dec 8 so procurement can sign a PO the week of Dec 13.

If convenient, can we do a 30-min sync on Friday to confirm owners?

—Emily
Senior Security Manager
ClearCoat Financial

Attachments: clearcoat-evidence-expectations.pdf (stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearcoat.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ClearCoat MAP: evidence owners + custody path questions

Emily —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers and a proposed plan below. We should be able to get the MAP gate items in place to hit your Dec 8 target.

1) Evidence custody: Redwood will produce a downloadable evidence bundle (PDF/XLSX packages) and also offer short-term redwood-managed access (S3-presigned URL) for your audit window. For the SOC 2 bridge we typically provide:
  - consolidated evidence index (PDF) with timestamps and reference links
  - raw log excerpts (redacted) where applicable
  - configuration snapshots (git diffs / IaC manifests)

We will mark each artifact with a custody field: "redwood-bundle" or "customer-extract".

2) SIG/CAIQ: we'll deliver a CAIQ XLSX with cell-level references to the evidence index. First-pass ETA: 3 business days (by Tue, 30 Nov). Finalized responses after your review: by Fri, 4 Dec.

3) DPA redlines: we reviewed the template. Section 5 retention carveouts are reasonable; two outstanding questions for legal (cc'd Kim): one small clarification on backup retention vs. primary retention windows, and a note on anonymized logging retention. We can accept the majority of proposed language and will post a redline (v3) by Thu, 26 Nov.

Proposed immediate next steps (MAP lane owners + dates):
  - Evidence index & bundle (owner: Priyom) — deliver 2026-11-30
  - CAIQ first-pass (owner: Rafael) — deliver 2026-11-30
  - DPA redlines v3 (owner: Kimberly) — deliver 2026-11-26
  - Final acceptance criteria doc (shared MAP) — deliver 2026-12-07

If that schedule works, Priyom and I can join your Friday sync to walk through the evidence index and custody model.

Thanks — Rafael
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ClearCoat MAP: internal owners and file stubs

Rafael / Kim —

Working through the evidence pack. Quick notes for the MAP:

- SOC 2 bridge items: I will produce the consolidated evidence index PDF and the redwood-bundle (presigned S3 artifacts). I will include a short manifest.csv with artifact_id, description, custody, timestamp, retention-category.
- For logs, I will include 7-day raw slices + aggregated metrics we use for monitoring. If ClearCoat needs longer slices, we can provide redacted exports but need a formal evidence request window.
- CAIQ: I will assemble the references in the XLSX Rafael mentioned. Expect an initial workbook with "reference" cells pointing to the manifest entries.
- DPA: Kimberly, flagging backup vs primary retention item for your review before I include any example artifacts.

I will attach three stubs to the MAP workspace by EOD Thu: soc2-bridge-evidence-index.pdf (stub), sig-caiq-responses-draft.xlsx (stub), DPA-redlines_v3.docx (stub).

—Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-bridge-evidence-index.pdf (stub), sig-caiq-responses-draft.xlsx (stub), DPA-redlines_v3.docx (stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearcoat.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, ClearCoat Security <security@clearcoat.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: MAP lane update: evidence bundle + acceptance checklist (RDW-3247)

Emily / team —

Follow-up after our sync today. Per the MAP lane we committed the initial artifacts and acceptance checklist to the shared Drive and HubSpot record. Summary:

Deliverables posted:
- soc2-bridge-evidence-index.pdf (attached to HubSpot, also available via presigned link) — owner: Priyom (delivered 2026-11-30)
- sig-caiq-responses-draft.xlsx — owner: Rafael (delivered 2026-11-30)
- DPA-redlines_v3.docx — owner: Kimberly (delivered 2026-11-26)
- Acceptance checklist (MAP lane) — owner: Rafael (draft posted 2026-12-02)

Key acceptance criteria for SOC 2 bridge gate (short):
  - Evidence index maps to each CAIQ control and shows custody field (redwood-bundle or customer-extract)
  - DPA retention windows aligned between section 5 and backup policy (Kim to confirm)
  - No open high/critical security items on the security review checklist (attached)

Next steps:
  - Emily to confirm whether ClearCoat will accept a redwood-managed presigned access model or require ingestion into ClearCoat's repository (requested decision by 2026-12-08).
  - After sign-off, procurement can issue PO and we will schedule a 30-day audit window for your team.

If helpful, I'm happy to circulate a single-page MAP lane export that you can attach to your procurement request.

Thanks — Rafael
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-bridge-evidence-index.pdf, sig-caiq-responses-draft.xlsx, DPA-redlines_v3.docx
